rationale.level_circuit_zero: Measure collateral changes from repurposing weak neuron paths, with the new circuit disconnected from the median.
rationale.level_circuit_plus_0.01: Program a signed recent-level correction: SiLU(x)-SiLU(-x)=x through paired units and a LayerNorm-cancelling difference. Reference 0.7 is in normalized fourth-root admission space; ED uses centered logit space and reference zero.
rationale.level_circuit_plus_0.03: Stronger programmed level dependence to counter mean reversion during large waves.
rationale.level_circuit_plus_0.06: Larger causal intervention for the same circuit.
rationale.level_circuit_minus_0.01: Opposite direction tests whether amplification, rather than mean reversion, causes errors.
